research_assumptions.signal: Long when SMA(50) > SMA(200), otherwise flat; require 200 complete daily closes
research_assumptions.execution: Signals shift one bar in the native runner and execute at next bar open
research_assumptions.exposure: Long/flat, maximum 1.0 target weight, no leverage above 1x
research_assumptions.fees: Taker 5 bps on entry; maker 2 bps on exit
research_assumptions.slippage: 5 bps adverse on every entry and exit
research_assumptions.funding: Fixed +1 bp per native daily fallback settlement while a position is open; long pays
research_assumptions.validation_note: Monte Carlo permutes realized trade PnLs and does not by itself test parameter selection overfit
